name: IKEA DUKTIG Felt Fruit and Vegetables

pages.title: DUKTIG 14-piece vegetables set  - IKEA UK
pages.description: DUKTIG 14-piece vegetables set Play is a fun way to learn about the colours, shapes and names of different vegetables. These are made of a soft material and are easy to wash, so your child can be just as creative as a master chef. Helps the child develop fine motor skills and hand/eye co-ordination.
pages.ld_description: DUKTIG 14-piece vegetables set. Fresh vegetables every day. What a luxury! Wondering what little chefs can create using what’s in the vegetable box? Maybe it will be a colourful salad or a savoury ratatouille? Yummy. Helps the child develop fine motor skills and hand/eye co-ordination.
